backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor defining all data types (UserProfile, Video, Comment, CarMeet, BuildLog, DirectMessage, Notification, etc.) and including MixinStorage and MixinAuthorization for a car-culture social platform with admin/user access control.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report linking the upload flow fix (v3 response body format) to the relevant frontend files and component dependencies, with high confidence.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON document containing short summaries of each frontend source file, describing their roles in the RevReel app including hooks, pages, and components.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base CSS file defining OKLCH-based CSS custom properties for light and dark theme color tokens used throughout the app.
frontend/index.html: Minimal HTML entry point for the RevReel Vite/React app, mounting the React root and loading the main TypeScript module.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Defines all TanStack Router routes under a shared layout, wiring pages like Feed, Profile, Upload, Discover, Inbox, Mechanics, CarMeets, BuildLogs, Classifieds, and AdminPanel into the app.
frontend/src/components/AuthGuard.tsx: Component that gates content behind Internet Identity authentication, showing a loading spinner, login prompt, or the wrapped children depending on auth state.
frontend/src/components/CarMeetCard.tsx: Card component displaying a car meet's title, category, location, date, and attendee count, with attend/leave toggle buttons for authenticated users.
frontend/src/components/ChallengeModal.t: A modal dialog that lets the current user select one of their videos to send a challenge to another user, using the postChallenge mutation and displaying loading/error states.
frontend/src/components/CommentsPanel.ts: A slide-in panel that displays sorted comments for a given video and allows authenticated users to post new comments, with relative timestamp formatting.
frontend/src/components/EditProfileModal: A modal form for editing the current user's profile, supporting username, bio, and avatar image upload with preview, backed by the updateProfile mutation.
frontend/src/components/FollowButton.tsx: A toggle button that follows or unfollows a user based on the current follower list, hidden when viewing one's own profile or when unauthenticated.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: The root application layout providing a fixed top header with navigation links, upload button, profile link, logout, and a bottom nav bar, plus a ProfileSetupModal trigger for new users.
frontend/src/components/PostIssueModal.t: A modal form for posting a car mechanics issue with title, category, and description fields, submitting via the createMechanicsPost mutation and showing toast notifications.
frontend/src/components/PostListingModal: A modal dialog component for creating a new parts/car listing, with form fields for title, make, model, year, price, condition, category, image URL, and description, submitted via the useCreateListing mutation.
frontend/src/components/PostMeetModal.ts: A modal dialog component for organizing a car meetup, collecting title, location, datetime, category, and description, then submitting via the useCreateCarMeet mutation with a nanosecond timestamp.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetupModa: A mandatory (non-dismissible) modal for first-time profile creation, allowing users to set a username, bio, and avatar image, then saving via the useSaveCallerUserProfile mutation.
frontend/src/components/StartBuildLogMod: A modal dialog for starting a new car build log, collecting a title, car make/model/year, and description, submitted via the useCreateBuildLog mutation.
frontend/src/components/VideoCard.tsx: A card component for displaying a video or photo post with support for likes, emoji reactions, save/unsave, comments panel, challenge modal, delete, view count tracking, and mute toggle for inline video playback.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: A custom hook that creates and caches an authenticated or anonymous backend actor using React Query, and invalidates all dependent queries whenever the actor (identity) changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides a React context and hook for Internet Identity authentication, managing login/logout state, identity persistence, and AuthClient creation with configurable options.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for all backend interactions including user profiles, videos, comments, and reactions, re-exporting relevant backend types for consumers.
frontend/src/index.css: Global stylesheet that imports Barlow fonts, configures Tailwind, defines CSS custom properties for a dark-mode design system with neon accents, and adds utility classes for neon effects and glass cards.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that renders the React app wrapped with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/src/pages/About.tsx: Static About page describing the RevReel platform with a hero section, feature list, and a copyable Cash App handle for donations.
frontend/src/pages/AdminPanel.tsx: Admin-only page that lists all users and allows deletion, gating access behind an auth guard and an admin role check via the backend actor.
frontend/src/pages/BuildLogDetails.tsx: Displays a single build log's details including car info, stages, and creation date. Allows the author to add new stages or delete the entire build log.
frontend/src/pages/BuildLogs.tsx: Lists all build logs with car details and stage counts, and lets authenticated users create a new build log via a modal.
frontend/src/pages/CarMeetDetails.tsx: Shows details for a specific car meet (location, date, category, attendees) and lets authenticated users join or leave the meet.
frontend/src/pages/CarMeets.tsx: Lists all car meets as cards and allows authenticated users to post a new meet via a modal.
frontend/src/pages/Classifieds.tsx: Displays active classified listings with image, price, and condition, and provides a link to post a new listing.
frontend/src/pages/Conversation.tsx: Renders a direct message conversation with a specific user, supporting sending messages, auto-scrolling, and marking messages as read.
frontend/src/pages/Discover.tsx: Discover page that lets users search videos and browse trending categories and hashtags, navigating to a filtered feed on selection.
frontend/src/pages/Feed.tsx: Main feed page that displays all videos sorted by timestamp in a vertically snapping scroll layout, wrapped in an AuthGuard.
frontend/src/pages/FilteredFeed.tsx: Filtered feed page that shows videos filtered by either category or hashtag based on URL params, with a back-navigation header.
frontend/src/pages/Inbox.tsx: Inbox page listing all user conversations with the other user's avatar, last message preview, timestamp, and unread count badge.
frontend/src/pages/LandingPage.tsx: Landing/marketing page with a hero section and login via Internet Identity, redirecting authenticated users to the feed.
frontend/src/pages/Leaderboard.tsx: Leaderboard page displaying top trending videos and top racers ranked by total likes, with a banner image header.
frontend/src/pages/ListingDetails.tsx: Detail page for a single classifieds listing showing its image, info, and seller profile, with a deactivate option for the listing owner.
frontend/src/pages/MechanicsHelp.tsx: Displays a list of mechanics help posts with loading skeletons and an empty state, and provides a button to open a modal for posting new issues.
Shows the detail view of a single mechanics help post including its comments, a comment submission form, and a delete option for the post author.
frontend/src/pages/Notifications.tsx: Renders the user's notification list with unread indicators, supports marking individual or all notifications as read, and navigates to the sender's profile on click.
frontend/src/pages/Profile.tsx: Displays a user's profile page with avatar, stats, badges, and tabbed sections for their uploaded videos and saved videos, with edit and follow functionality.
frontend/src/pages/Upload.tsx: Provides a form for uploading videos or photos with title, description, category, hashtags, and optional thumbnail, tracking upload progress and navigating to the feed on success.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility module for reading URL query parameters from both standard and hash-based routes, with helpers for persisting values in sessionStorage and cleaning sensitive params from the URL.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration for the frontend, defining dark mode, custom fonts (Barlow/Barlow Condensed), OKLCH-based color tokens, border radii, neon box shadows, accordion keyframes, and enabling typography, container-queries, and animate plugins.
project_state.json: Tracks the RevReel project state at version 3, recording one existing fix feature targeting the upload flow's 'expected v3 response body' error and noting that upload currently fails with that error.
